title: Injectivity can be checked on subobjects of a generator
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that an object of a Grothendieck abelian category with a generator is injective exactly when every extension problem from a subobject of the generator can be solved (statement lines 1670-1686). The proof is a complete argument: it starts from an arbitrary injection and morphism into the object (proof lines 1688-1692), reduces the extension problem to the case where the source is built from copies of the generator (proof lines 1692-1705), applies the hypothesis on the pieces, and glues the compatible extensions to obtain the extension property, hence injectivity (proof lines 1705-1712). The non-formal content is the reduction to the generator and the gluing. The claim is H2.
